name: Twilio Developer Kit
description: 开发 Twilio 消息、语音、Verify、SendGrid 和会话集成，验证回调与实际通信状态。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.connect
skills.description: 配置 Twilio / SendGrid 账户、最小权限与开发环境。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.design
skills.description: 为消息通知、营销、身份核验和客户服务选择 Twilio 产品。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.messaging
skills.description: 开发 Twilio 多渠道消息、模板、号码与发送者流程。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.voice
skills.description: 构建 Twilio Voice、TwiML、会议与录音工作流。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.verify
skills.description: 接入 Twilio Verify 和 Lookup 并处理身份验证状态。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.email
skills.description: 开发 SendGrid 发信、模板、抑制列表和投递诊断。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.webhooks
skills.description: 实现 Twilio Webhook 验签、幂等处理与可靠回调。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.conversations
skills.description: 开发 Twilio Conversations、Agent Connect 与跨渠道编排。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.contact-center
skills.description: 设计 Twilio TaskRouter 路由和人工接管。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.intelligence
skills.description: 接入 Twilio Conversation Intelligence 和 Enterprise Knowledge。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.compliance
skills.description: 按 Twilio 官方规则准备发送者注册、权限与通信合规资料。

skills.name: cotree.twilio-developer-kit.debug
skills.description: 诊断 Twilio 发送失败、回调和账户权限。
